long_biography.plain_text:
Richard Branson crossed the Pacific in a hot-air balloon with Per Lindstrand in 1991, flying from Japan to northern Canada. The Virgin founder and his Swedish companion had already made the first hot-air balloon crossing of the Atlantic. Their Pacific journey established records for distance and duration, extending a partnership built around experimental aviation.

Three decades later, Branson joined the first fully crewed test flight of Virgin Galactic, the space-travel business he founded. His assignment on Unity 22 was to evaluate the private astronaut experience. The mission tested cabin conditions and the activities planned for passengers during weightlessness, making him a participant in the development of the service his company intended to sell.
long_biography.html:
Richard Branson crossed the Pacific in a hot-air balloon with Per Lindstrand in 1991, flying from Japan to northern Canada. The Virgin founder and his Swedish companion had already made the first hot-air balloon crossing of the Atlantic. Their Pacific journey established records for distance and duration, extending a partnership built around experimental aviation.

Three decades later, Branson joined the first fully crewed test flight of Virgin Galactic, the space-travel business he founded. His assignment on Unity 22 was to evaluate the private astronaut experience. The mission tested cabin conditions and the activities planned for passengers during weightlessness, making him a participant in the development of the service his company intended to sell.
